results.device_name: Digital Pathology Image Viewing And Management Software
results.definition: Digital pathology image viewing and management software device is a software intended for viewing and management of digital images of scanned surgical pathology slides prepared from formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) tissue. It is an aid to the pathologist to review and interpret these digital images for the purposes of primary diagnosis.
